text: In May 2023 NB Renaissance signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of U-Power, with founder Franco Uzzeni reinvesting for a 30% stake; Uzzeni continues to lead U-Power as Chairman and CEO.

source.name: NB Renaissance press release: 'NB Renaissance and the Uzzeni family announce their partnership in U-Power'
source.quote: NB Renaissance signed a binding agreement to acquire 100% of U-Power

additionalSources.name: Oaklins Italy deal page: 'U-Power Group has been sold to NB Renaissance'
additionalSources.quote: NB Renaissance Partners Holdings Sarl has acquired a majority stake in U-Power Group S.p.A.
